questions.prompt: Where was the longest dry spell ever recorded, without any measurable rain (WMO)?
questions.teaser: Where did it go longest without rain?
questions.turnsOut: Arica, on the edge of Chile's Atacama Desert: no measurable rain for 172 months, from October 1903 to January 1918. Over 59 years its rainfall averaged 0.76 mm a year, the lowest in South America.
questions.sourceTitle: WMO Weather and Climate Extremes Archive: records table (31 July 2025)

questions.prompt: Where was the highest air temperature ever recorded on Earth (WMO)?
questions.teaser: Where was the hottest temperature ever recorded?

targets.label: Furnace Creek (Greenland Ranch), Death Valley, California, USA

questions.turnsOut: Furnace Creek in Death Valley, California, 54 m below sea level: 56.7 °C (134 °F) on 10 July 1913. Libya's 58 °C from 1922 held the title until a WMO panel threw it out in 2012.
questions.sourceTitle: WMO Weather and Climate Extremes Archive: records table (31 July 2025)

questions.prompt: Where was the strongest wind gust ever measured, outside a tornado (WMO)?
questions.teaser: Where was the strongest gust of wind ever measured?
questions.turnsOut: Barrow Island, off Western Australia: 113.2 m/s (408 km/h) as Cyclone Olivia passed on 10 April 1996. The WMO only confirmed it in 2010, ending the reign of Mount Washington's 103.3 m/s gust from 1934.
questions.sourceTitle: WMO Weather and Climate Extremes Archive: records table (31 July 2025)
